caption: The drawing depicts two textile samples on a plain, off-white background. The larger textile sample is rectangular and features a detailed, symmetrical pattern incorporating red, green, blue, and beige colors. The design includes repeating geometric and floral motifs, with horizontal bands of green and blue creating separation between sections dominated by red and beige forms. The lower band of the cloth consists of a series of small, evenly spaced geometric shapes in beige and red, bordered by a horizontal green stripe. The edges of this textile are slightly frayed. Below the larger sample, there is a smaller, square textile piece characterized by a simplified pattern with jagged, angular shapes, mainly in red and beige. This smaller piece has no additional colors or borders and is positioned directly beneath the central area of the larger textile. Both samples are presented flat on the page, with no visible mounting or additional objects around them.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
